story_info.title: Oliver Fox's Teamwork Fort
story_info.subtitle: Friends make big jobs easy!
story_info.moral: Friends help each other, and teamwork makes things better.

main_character.name: Oliver Fox
main_character.appearance: Oliver is a slim young fox with bright orange-red fur, a fluffy white-tipped tail, and perky triangular ears. He has clever amber eyes and a playful, confident grin.

supporting_characters.name: Squeaky Squirrel
supporting_characters.appearance: a small grey squirrel with a fluffy tail and bright brown eyes.

cover.prompt: Pixar-quality 3D illustration of Oliver Fox, a slim young fox with bright orange-red fur, a fluffy white-tipped tail, and perky triangular ears, clever amber eyes, and a playful, confident grin. He is pulling one end of a large tree branch. Squeaky Squirrel, a small grey squirrel with a fluffy tail and bright brown eyes, is pushing the other end of the branch. They are in a sunny forest clearing with gentle light. Children's book illustration style. Vertical composition. Instagram friendly. Soft lighting. Pastel colours.
cover.visual_action: Oliver Fox and Squeaky Squirrel working together to move a large branch

slides.title: A New Idea!
slides.text: Oliver Fox skipped into Sunny Forest. The sun shone bright. He found some big branches. "I will build a super fort!" he thought. Oliver was very creative. He picked up a small branch. It was easy to move. He started to plan his fort. He knew it would be the best.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver Fox starts building a fort in Sunny Forest, full of excitement.

slides.title: Too Heavy!
slides.text: Soon, Oliver found a very big branch. It was perfect for the roof! He pushed and pulled very hard with all his might. But the branch would not move. It was too heavy for one fox. Oliver tried again. Still, the branch stayed put. He thought, "This is a big challenge!" Oliver did not give up.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver struggles to move a heavy branch by himself, facing a challenge.

slides.title: A Friendly Helper
slides.text: Just then, Squeaky Squirrel ran by. Squeaky had a fluffy tail and bright brown eyes. He saw Oliver trying hard. "Hello, Oliver!" said Squeaky. "What are you building?" Oliver smiled at his friend. "A fort!" he said. "But this big branch is very heavy." Squeaky looked at the branch.
slides.speaker_notes: Squeaky Squirrel appears and sees Oliver struggling with the branch.

slides.title: Teamwork Time!
slides.text: "Let's solve it together!" said Oliver. "Can you push that end?" Squeaky nodded. "Yes, I can help!" Oliver pulled his end. Squeaky pushed his end. One, two, three, UP! The big branch lifted. They carefully moved it to the fort. Oliver and Squeaky cheered.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver and Squeaky work together, using teamwork to lift the heavy branch.

slides.title: Our Special Fort
slides.text: With Squeaky's help, the fort was soon finished. It was strong and cosy inside. Oliver and Squeaky sat together. "Thank you, Squeaky!" said Oliver. "Teamwork makes big jobs easy." Squeaky giggled. "Yes, friends help friends." They felt happy and proud. They built something great together.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver and Squeaky enjoy their finished fort, reflecting on their teamwork and friendship.

But when he finds a perfect, big branch, it's just too heavy for him alone. Can Oliver solve this big problem? Luckily, his friend Squeaky Squirrel hops by!
